operating_notes.text: Income-tax demand for AY2018-19 reduced to ₹40.28 lakh from ₹7.19 Cr by a Section 154 rectification order received 28 April 2026; appeal and Section 270A penalty proceedings pending.
Monitoring agency report confirms full utilization of ₹114.30 Cr preferential warrant proceeds by 31 March 2026 with a minor ₹0.54 Cr inter-object shift to capex.
FY26 associate VKT Pharma (34.83% held) contributed ₹13.99 Cr share of profit; its own FY26 revenue was ₹239.88 Cr and PAT ₹40.17 Cr.
FY26 capex was ₹130.56 Cr against operating cash flow of ₹59.22 Cr; borrowings rose to ₹365.05 Cr at March 2026.
FY26 revenue grew 13% YoY to ₹886.87 Cr driven by backward integration and growth across key APIs.
Ibuprofen capacity is being expanded to 800 metric tons per month under the current capex program.
Company filed a police complaint with the Economic Offences Wing, Hyderabad regarding fraudulent claims on 85,000 physical shares.
Executed an unsecured loan agreement to lend up to ₹50 Cr to 99.99% subsidiary SMS Peptides Private Limited for its business purpose; nil outstanding as on date of disclosure.

timeline.summary: 29 Apr 2026: SMS Pharmaceuticals said a Section 154 rectification order cut its AY2018-19 income-tax demand to ₹40.28 lakh from ₹7.19 Cr; appeal and Section 270A penalty proceedings continue.
On 15 May 2026, SMS Pharmaceuticals submitted its monitoring agency report showing full utilization of ₹114.30 Cr preferential warrant issue proceeds by 31 March 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹237.95 Cr (-4.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹33 Cr (includes ₹11.75 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹20.96 Cr).
SMS Pharmaceuticals reported FY26 revenue of ₹886.87 Cr, up 13% YoY, and PAT of ₹102 Cr, driven by backward integration.
On May 23, 2026, SMS Pharmaceuticals reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹886.87 Cr and PAT of ₹101.98 Cr, and issued its investor presentation.
Thirumalesh Tumma, Director, shared the audio recording of the Analysts/Investors Conference Call on 27th May 2026 via the company’s website.
On 27 May 2026, SMS Pharmaceuticals held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, guiding for over 15% revenue growth in FY27.
SMS Pharmaceuticals reported a fraudulent physical share transfer scheme involving 85,000 shares to the Economic Offences Wing on June 5, 2026.
SMS Pharmaceuticals signed a loan agreement to lend up to ₹50 Cr to subsidiary SMS Peptides Private Limited.
SMS Pharmaceuticals received a favorable income tax appellate order vacating a ₹45.63 Cr demand for AY 2023-24.
SMS Pharmaceuticals received an appellate order dismissing its appeal against a ₹7.19 Cr tax demand for AY 2018-19.
